tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You and your friend, Jasmine, are planning to host a fundraising event for a local children's hospital. You have some ideas for activities and entertainment to include in the event, but you need Jasmine's input to finalize the plans. You also want to discuss the best time to meet and organize the details.
Write an email to Jasmine. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe your ideas for the fundraising event.
Explain why you think these activities will be successful.
Suggest a time to meet and discuss the plans in more detail.
tasks.subject: Fundraising event planning
tasks.sample:
Dear Jasmine,



I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to you because I just thought of two activities for our fundraising event for the local children's hospital. The first activity is for children to make and sell simple artworks, and the second is to hold a live show by local students who are music majors.



I believe these activities can be successful because they cater to different groups—crafts will attract families with children, while a live show can be appealing to adults and couples. Simultaneously, these activities are low-cost yet engaging, helping boost participation and fundraising results.



Then, we need to find a time to discuss more details. Could we meet this Saturday at 2 PM at the community cafe to finalize the details? Please let me know if this time suits you, and I look forward to hearing from you.



Best regards,

Alfonso
tasks.title: Write an Email
